items.q: I'm an international student. Does my visa affect eligibility?
items.a: We can work with almost any visa case: D‑2 (student), D‑4 (training), F‑2, F‑4, F‑6, and more. A visa guide is included as a bonus, and during 1:1 mentoring we map out the employment paths that fit your specific status.

items.q: Can I keep up if my Korean is not strong?
items.a: All lectures are delivered in Korean, so you need at least basic conversational Korean to follow along. Some support materials, like the visa guide, are provided in both Korean and English.

items.q: Can I take the program online?
items.a: No online sessions. The point of this program is hands-on time at a real audio console and inside a real stage environment, which cannot be delivered through a screen. Only residents of Korea (D‑2, D‑4, D‑10, E‑series, etc.) can apply. Some support materials, like the visa guide, are provided separately as PDFs.

100% refund within 7 days of payment or before the program starts. After the program starts, refunds follow the Korean Private Education Act Enforcement Decree (Table 4) and the Fair Trade Commission consumer dispute guidelines: 2/3 before 1/3 of the program, 1/2 before halfway, no refund after halfway. This class recruits 30 students, and if fewer than 20 have paid by the deadline (Sunday, June 21, 2026, midnight), the class is canceled, all payments are refunded in full automatically, and we re-open recruitment for the next class.

Bank transfer only (domestic KRW). Credit cards and foreign-issued cards are not supported. After you submit the application form, you receive a confirmation email within 24 hours with the bank details (account holder: Dropdown Co., Ltd., Toss Bank 1002-4759-1521).

items.q: How many seats are there in each class?
items.a: Each class runs with a small group to keep the mentor-to-student ratio tight. Once seats are full, applications close immediately and the rest of the queue rolls into the next class.

items.q: Where does the certificate come from?
items.a: Dropdown Co., Ltd. issues the four-week certificate. Students who actually work the K‑pop concert also receive a separate concert project participation letter issued by Union Pictures (K‑pop concert production studio). Both documents carry weight inside the Korean entertainment industry and can be used on your résumé.

items.q: How many 1:1 mentor sessions do I get during the program?
items.a: You get 1:1 sessions with the three mentors (sound director, visual director, networking lead) during the four-week program. Both career and technical tracks are covered. The exact number is tailored to your track in coordination with the mentors.

items.q: Can everyone join the concert project field experience?
items.a: Yes. Every graduate gets hands-on time at a real K‑pop concert. No extra payment, and the schedule is separate from the four weeks of classes. After you confirm interest, schedule, role, and headcount are matched. Those who actually work the show receive a concert project participation letter issued by Union Pictures.

items.q: Will I stay in touch with my class and mentors after the program?
items.a: Yes. The moment your seat is confirmed, you join the KakaoTalk open chat, and it stays open for life. Future classes join too, so the alumni network keeps growing.
We do not guarantee a job. What we do guarantee: a portfolio and résumé recruiters trust, real interview patterns, and direct lines to the mentors. See the three guarantees section above.

sections.title: Purpose

(hereafter "Company") and users in connection with growthcareer.xyz (hereafter "Site") and the Fan to Pro program (hereafter "Program") offered through the Site. sections.title: Definitions
items: "Company": Dropdown Co., Ltd. The party that develops and operates growthcareer.xyz.
"Site": all pages and features provided through the growthcareer.xyz domain.
"Program": Fan to Pro. The K‑pop entertainment job training program operated by the Company.
"DEEPI": a partner (production partner) that supports program operations, including instructor sourcing. A subsidiary of Union Pictures.

"Union Pictures": Union Pictures (K‑pop concert production studio). The party operating concert projects and the issuer of the concert project participation letter to actual participants. Provides concert project field experience to graduates who meet the operating criteria.
"User": any person who accesses the Site or applies for the Program.

sections.title: Effect and changes to the Terms
paragraphs: These Terms become effective upon posting on the Site. The Company may amend the Terms within the limits of applicable law, with notice on the Site at least 7 days before the effective date. For changes that are unfavorable to users, the Company gives notice at least 30 days in advance and notifies users individually via email or other means.

sections.title: Roles of the Company and its partners
items: Company (Dropdown Co., Ltd.): Site development and operation, application intake, tuition collection (account holder), class schedule and graduation management, data management, user support, responsibility for the Terms and Privacy Policy.
DEEPI: a partner that supports program operations including instructor sourcing. Does not receive student personal data.
Union Pictures: provides K‑pop concert project field experience to all graduates and issues the concert project participation letter to those who actually work the show.

Referred applicant (new applicant): applicants who, after submitting the application, reply to the payment guide SMS or email with the referrer's exact full name are eligible for a KRW 50,000 tuition discount (final payment KRW 830,000).
Each referrer is eligible for up to five (5) referral rewards, and matching is based on the referrer's exact name (Korean or English name as used on the application form or the payment record).
If the referred applicant receives a refund, the corresponding referral reward will not be paid; if already paid, the Company may recover it.

This policy is part of the Company's promotional activity and is operated at no more than KRW 50,000 per reward in accordance with Article 84(4) of the Income Tax Act (minimum threshold for other income taxation). The Company records such rewards as promotional expenses for accounting purposes.
The Company may terminate this policy at its discretion. Any termination will be announced in advance on the website and the KakaoTalk channel.
